countedBy: lane #209 (opus) from the rectified panorama crops of the brief (w01-248 Bilderdijkstraat, w02-67 Da Costakade); ribbon convention; a door and a shop window count. Not a blind count; the integrator may re-count.

facades.name: corner house, Bilderdijkstraat 155-157
facades.note: w01-248 (recording_2025-07-31_08-46-40_01995, 2025-07-31), corner house at the photo's left. Storey 1: the tripartite window (0.4/1.1/0.4 m lights, mullions under 0.3 m: one opening) and four single windows; storey 2 the same (the left lights behind the balcony and a tree); storey 3: the north half is behind the tree (null); the dormer's round-headed window. Ground shops cut by the parked van, outside the crop.

facades.name: dairy, Bilderdijkstraat 157a-161
facades.note: w01-248: the stone ground with its arches is below the crop (vans, ivy). Three storeys of nine axes (three in the gable bay, six to the right; the gable bay's first axis is behind the tree trunk, its two neighbours line up with the gable lights above). Cropped at the eaves (15.2 m): the gable's three round-headed lights (the middle one taller, as photographed) and the dormer are one row of unequal openings by design.

facades.name: factory, north side part
facades.note: w01-248: ground: two windows (the wooden double door is solid, not counted); mezzanine: five small arched lights; storey 2: three segmental windows; storey 3 is behind the tree (null).

facades.name: factory, four middle bays
facades.note: w01-248: one high segmental workshop window per bay on the ground (the shop doors stand inside two of them), one four-light window per bay on storeys 2 and 3 (mullions under 0.3 m: one opening each); the third bay's upper windows are partly behind the slim tree, the rhythm shows them.

facades.name: factory, south side part
facades.note: w01-248: ground: two windows (the wooden door is solid, not counted); mezzanine: five small arched lights; storeys 2 and 3: three segmental windows each.

facades.name: 1909 range, Da Costakade 158-164
facades.note: w02-67 (TMX7316010203-001702_pano_0000_005491, 2020-05-11): ground: six tall cross windows (the four-leaf gate and the green panelled doors at both ends are solid, not counted; at the left edge the two door top lights show over the van); mezzanine windows over the four end doors; three storeys of twelve cross windows; four dormers in the mansard.

facades.name: Merkelbach and Karsten block, tiled bay
facades.note: w02-67: the steel door in the tiled bay, the ground ribbon above it, then the four storeys of continuous ribbons (cropped to this bay).

facades.name: Merkelbach and Karsten block, bays 2-4
facades.note: w02-67: three ground bays between the concrete columns, each lower glazing with its red door at one end (thin frames: one opening per bay), each with an upper ribbon; four storeys of continuous ribbons (cropped). The roof storey is above the frame (cropped at 26 m).

facades.name: Merkelbach and Karsten block, north bay
facades.note: w02-67: the north bay at the photo's right edge: lower glazing with its red door at the left end, the upper ribbon, four storeys of ribbons (cropped).
